newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ARSENAL MAKE COMPLAINT OVER WRIGHT'S DISMISSAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ARSENAL MAKE COMPLAINT OVER WRIGHT'S DISMISSAL.

text.p: English premier division side Arsenal submitted an official complaint to the Football Association (F.A.) on Monday about Ian Wright's sending-off at Nottingham Forest on Saturday.
Referee Stephen Lodge dismissed Wright for violent conduct, an offence which carries an automatic three-match ban, after the Arsenal striker clashed with Forest defender Nikola Jerkan.
The F.A. said Lodge and assistant referee John Holbrook would be sent a videotape of the incident and asked for their observations.
Lodge said he had not seen the incident but had relied on the evidence of Holbrook before showing Wright the red card.
Wright had scored his 21st goal of the season to give championship-chasing Arsenal the lead before his sending-off at the City ground.
Forest went on to record only their second league win of the season, thanks to two goals from Norwegian Alf Inge Haaland.
